description: Highly customizable dashboard that puts all your feeds in one place.

promotion.reason: Qualified on 2026-09-11 and approved by the owner. A real install proved it starts, opens to a usable screen, survives a restart and a keep-data reinstall with its data intact, and removes everything it created. v0.8.6 is upstream's current release, built 2026-09-03. It failed every earlier run because the starter glance.yml Runtipi ships beside the definition was never copied in; seed-file support is what fixed it.

risk_notes: Creates 1 Docker container and publishes one port on this computer's loopback interface only.
Keeps its data in this app's managed folder. A keep-data uninstall leaves it; deleting data removes it permanently.
Proven on Windows with Docker's Linux engine. macOS and Linux hosts are unverified.

Out of the box its dashboard fetches from Twitch, YouTube, Reddit, Hacker News, a weather service, a stock-quote service and several blogs, from this computer, every few hours. What it shows is set by data/glance.yml in its folder — Runtipi's starter file, written on first install and never overwritten — and there is no in-app editor.
